text: The most serious crime he can be convicted of is involuntary manslaughter, because his unlawful act (shooting at the opposing player's leg) was a misdemeanor or low-level felony not inherently dangerous enough to support felony murder, and he lacked malice toward the actual victim. The transferred intent doctrine does not elevate the killing to murder here because his intent was only to inflict a slight wound, not to kill or cause serious bodily harm. CONFIDENCE: 80
